text:
maria: Quick check — canary rack slot assignment for next-week burn-in. We have 8 H100s arriving Tue; who owns final slot mapping? Need to lock by EOD Fri. @owen?

owen: I can take ownership of mapping but need the rack sequence from infra. Maria, do we have the reservation IDs yet?

maria: Not yet — procurement said manifest v3 lands tomorrow morning. Plan is to reserve pool `dedicated-canary`.

jin: FYI QA needs 2 nodes pinned for perf baselines. If mapping moves, we'll get noisy metrics. Please tag those nodes with label `canary:perf`.

alex: Noted — I can add labels during post-provision. Also quick question: is there a circuit-breaker for slot overcommit? Last wave autoscaler nabbed a node and bumped the canary.

sofia: Ops request — please include power/circuit IDs in the ticket. We had a mismatch in row 12 last wave and it took onsite an hour to trace.

maria: Thanks. @owen can you run the reservation CLI after manifest lands? Example command for the run: ```
ri reserve --pool=dedicated-canary --count=8 --meta=canary,week-12
```

owen: Yep. I'll run it once I have the manifest and rack sequence. ETA Mon noon PT. I'll ping this thread with the reservation id.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot created ticket INFRA-9832 for rack preflight; smoke window Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC.

jin: Small ask — please don't enable cross-customer routing for these nodes; add `no_public_routing=true` to the reservation. Keeps telemetry stable.

owen: Good call. Will add that flag when reserving.

alex: Also opening a tiny CR for the node-init script to ensure kvcache priming runs before test harness starts: PR 4567. Reviewers: @sofia, @jin. Please take a look by EOD Tue so we can avoid warmup noise.

sofia: Will review later today and leave comments.

maria: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker earlier, drop into #eng-runtime; otherwise I'll post the reservation id + rack mapping once done. :thumbsup:
